She smiled, reaching for her own stack of postcards, already planning the note she’d write back.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还浸在半醒的薄雾里，路灯把橘色的光揉进湿漉漉的柏油路，没有白日的车水马龙，只有偶尔驶过的夜班公交，载着寥寥几个裹着外套的乘客。巷口的早餐铺已经亮起暖黄的灯，蒸笼冒着细白的蒸汽，揉面的轻响飘到街对面，远处的高楼还沉在墨色剪影里，连风都放轻了脚步，怕惊扰了仍在酣眠的人。", "w03": "- Imagine you are standing in a line of people trying to count your position from the front; you simply ask the person directly in front of you what their position is, then add one to that number.\n- That person does the exact same thing: they ask the person ahead of them, add one, all the way until you reach the very first person in line, who knows they are in position one without asking anyone.\n- Once that answer travels back down the line, you stack all the added ones to get your position, and recursion is just that: solving a tiny copy of the same problem until you hit a simple starting point, then building the full answer back up."}
